title: First visit: date range defaults to This Year and data is fetched automatically
preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user allowed to open the report.
  2. You are using a browser with NO saved view for this report (e.g. a fresh browser profile or after clearing the site's browser storage), so first-visit defaults apply.
steps:
1. Open Reports → Parts → Parts Velocity.
  2. Look at the date range selector and the table without touching anything.
expected:
1. The date range selector shows This Year.
2. Report data loads automatically - you do not have to press anything to fetch it.
3. Rows appear ranked by Demand, highest first (the default order).

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Parts Velocity report specification version 11 (S1-R2, S4-R6), read on 17 August 2026.
